name: Jamaican Sorrel Soda
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 hibiscus (roselle) tea bags or 3 tsp (15 ml) dried hibiscus
6 each. ¼ in (0.67 cm) cubes of ginger (optional)

steps: Combine the water, hibiscus, and ginger in a pot. Boil for about 15 minutes.
Remove and discard the hibiscus and ginger.
Stir the sugar into the liquid, and simmer until you have about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
Remove from the heat and let cool.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of sparkling water.

culture.text: Jamaican sorrel soda is a traditional Jamaican carbonated drink consisting of sweetened hibiscus tea with added ginger.
